column2: Greg Moakes (Lab){{efn|Moakes had been a [[Kippax, West Yorkshire|Kippax]] and [[Swillington]] ward councillor since [[1973 Leeds City Council election|1973]].}}

column23: Andrea McKenna (Lab){{efn|Harrison had married [[Armley (ward)|Armley]] councillor James McKenna and taken his name since her last election.}}

column5: David Schofield (Con){{efn|For the next election in [[1986 Leeds City Council election|1986]], Schofield successfully stood instead as the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative]] candidate for [[Halton, Leeds|Halton]] ward and did not re-stand for Garforth and Swillington. He later represented [[Temple Newsam (ward)|Temple Newsam]] ward.}}
column18: Karen Marshall (Lab){{efn|Groves stood under her new name of Karen Marshall. She lost her re-election bid at the [[2004 Leeds City Council election|2004]] election and, then Karen Bruce, was later elected for [[Rothwell (ward)|Rothwell]] ward in [[2011 Leeds City Council election|2011]].}}
column30: Mark Dobson (GSI){{efn|Dobson resigned from the Labour council group to form and lead a new Garforth & Swillington Independents group on the council. He stated he was "increasingly uncomfortable with the direction and leadership of the Leeds Labour group." His ward colleague, Sarah Field, resigned the Labour whip three days later. She cited similar concerns to Dobson having "grown increasingly uneasy with the direction, priorities and manoeuvring of the Labour Group”.}}
